subject: Vendor onboarding: purchase reference allocation and multi-currency line-item correction
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@ventra-systems.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: vendor-portal@ventra-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-16T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Ventra onboarding form + PO details attached

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick handoff earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding packet (Ventra_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and an extracted CSV of the line items we expect to map to the Purchase Reference once the PO is issued (PO_LineItems_CSV.csv).

Two quick notes that I want to flag up front so the mapping doesn't get rejected by your system:
- We price several line items in EUR (regional hardware shipments) and the rest in USD. The CSV column "currency" is populated.
- Our contract asks for a single purchase reference, but we need the PX to be split into two spend bands (USD cap $150k / EUR cap €120k) to match our internal billing.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Issue a single Purchase Reference that supports per-line currency tags so your ledger reflects the currency correctly, or
2) Issue two linked Purchase References (one USD, one EUR) and associate both with the same onboarding record?

If neither is possible, let me know and we'll rework the CSV to consolidate. We're trying to avoid duplicate invoices across AP.

Thanks — attaching files here.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations, Ventra Systems
elena.ruiz@ventra-systems.com
+44 20 5555 1212

Attachments: Ventra_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), PO_LineItems_CSV.csv (csv)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@ventra-systems.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Ventra onboarding form + PO details attached

Folks — forwarding Ventra's files. Key ask: their line items include mixed currencies and they'd like either per-line currency mapping on a single purchase reference or two linked PRs.

Immediate asks:
- Priyom: can the procurement issuance workflow accept currency metadata per line? If not, can we emit two PRs that are linked in the system so operations treats them as one onboarding?
- Marcus: finance needs visibility on FX handling and spendcap enforcement for the EUR band. If we split PRs, will spendcap checks run independently?

I'm copying Monica for onboarding ticket continuity — please advise on what you need from Ventra to avoid a delay.

If we can resolve within today we'll issue a provisional PR so vendor onboarding can continue.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Vendor Enablement
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

--- Original attachments listed by vendor (see attached) ---

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai; Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@ventra-systems.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T12:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Ventra onboarding form + PO details attached

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 09:05 AM PST kimberly.park@redwood.ai wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Ventra's files. Key ask: their line items include mixed currencies and they'd like either per-line currency mapping on a single purchase reference or two linked PRs.

Thanks Kim — quick summary from procurement side:
1) Our current issuance system stores a single currency at the PR level. We do not have per-line currency in the canonical PR object today.
2) We can create two PRs (PR-USD-XXXX and PR-EUR-YYYY) and link them via a parent-child relationship in the backend ledger so upstream systems treat them as tied. That will require a manual audit note and cross-PR spendcap logic to be enforced by Finance.

Proposed path to avoid blocking Ventra:
- Create two provisional PRs today under the onboarding ticket (TKT-90871). Labels: "Ventra - USD (cap $150,000)" and "Ventra - EUR (cap €120,000)".
- Marcus/Finance to confirm whether we should: a) apply a hard cap per PR (the vendor's ask) or b) allow a pooled cap with a currency conversion step applied.
- Monica — can you open the onboarding ticket in Ops and attach an action item for the vendor to confirm acceptance of two PRs linked to their account? We need their sign-off before we finalize.

I'll prepare the provisional PRs but won't finalize issuance until finance confirms the spendcap enforcement.

—Priyom
Procurement Operations
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments: none

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai; Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@ventra-systems.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Ventra onboarding form + PO details attached

Thanks — I've reviewed the CSV and the proposed split. Quick notes from Finance:
- We prefer hard caps per PR to match Ventra's internal billing and simplify AP reconciliation. That means PR-USD-12872 will have a hard cap $150,000 and PR-EUR-12873 will have hard cap €120,000.
- We will not pool the caps; FX conversions introduce audit complexity and reconciliation lag.
- Action for Procurement: tag both PRs with GL codes and include an FX-rate note for EUR lines (snapshot at issuance) so AP knows which rate to use when processing vendor invoices.

Kimberly / Priyom — go ahead and issue two provisional PRs under ticket TKT-90871. Monica, please attach the provisional PR numbers to the onboarding ticket and ping Ventra for sign-off.

Elena — once we have your OK on two PRs, we'll switch them from provisional to active and email the official PR numbers. If you prefer a single PR approach, we'll need a separate exception request and at least one-week lead time while engineering updates the PR schema.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

---
Thread status: provisional PRs created pending vendor sign-off and GL tagging.
